title: Meta says Muse Image includes an invisible watermarking system called Content Seal and previews a web tool to check whether an image was generated with Meta AI (Karissa Bell/Engadget)
summary: Karissa Bell / Engadget: Meta says Muse Image includes an invisible watermarking system called Content Seal and previews a web tool to check whether an image was generated with Meta AI — It has rate limits for some reason. — Meta is working on a tool to ID images and video created with its new image generation model, Muse Image.
